sources.title: HarmonyOS UI, resource, and Chinese-comment contract supplied and approved in task context
claims: The CatchElf sample module is an implementation reference for page and dialog conventions.
UI colors and user-visible strings must not be magic literals and must be declared under src/main/resources/base/element.
New or materially changed classes and methods must include Chinese comments explaining responsibilities or logic.
The Domain Owner approved implementing the proposed rule, workflow, evaluator, reference, and project-overlay boundaries.

The Domain Owner clarified that a framework version difference or API-level warning is not direct proof of functional failure: it is a warning by default, fails only on observed failure or an explicit hard gate, and blocks only a task-required compatibility claim whose evidence is unavailable.

sources.title: CatchElf HarmonyOS sample HAR
claims: The sample is a HAR using HMRouter, ComponentV2, centralized SamplePath constants, and SamplePageInfo metadata.
Its initial state placed the dialog under pages, used visible text literals, did not consume its string and float resources, lacked color.json, and lacked Chinese responsibility comments.
The exemplar must be corrected and build-verified before it can be cited as a conforming reference.

sources.title: OpenHarmony SIG ohrouter and installed @hadss/hmrouter 1.2.4 documentation
claims: HMRouter supports annotation-declared ordinary, Dialog, and singleton pages.
The pageUrl annotation parameter supports string constants.
HMRouter supports HAR, HSP, and HAP modules.
The installed README documents @HMRouter page declarations and HMRouterMgr navigation for version 1.2.4.
